sourceRisks.meaning: Shapes may include outlined text or mathematical symbols; presence is not confirmation of text.
Bitmap presence does not establish embedded text; visual/source review required.

nativeDecisions.graphText: 56 native labels from reviewed outlined glyphs, including authored upper negative signs. Source grid and curve strokes preserved; source pink cells with glyph-shaped holes become one pink rectangle. Native A-D headings replace decorative discs.
nativeDecisions.feedback: Seven exact titles and source title alpha. Answer-specific authored wrong text, Close availability, exit frame, attempt increment and parent resume retained. Decorative feedback art does not establish original-runtime visual fidelity.
nativeDecisions.audio: Seven MP3 plus one source-bound ADPCM decode at22050Hz; entry2 uses ceil sourceblock resample; original runtime/resampler phase and listening pending
nativeDecisions.layout: Responsive two-column A,C/B,D with source A motion/zoom progress; native text never scaled; local graph scroll at narrow or enlarged text settings.
